name: samarth-runtime-worker
description: Read-only runtime capture worker for the Samarth GTM audit portal. Loads pages in headless Chromium and records analytics network hits, dataLayer snapshots, and console/page errors. NOT for Vercel — deploy to a host with a real browser (Render/Fly/Railway/VPS).

scripts.check: node --check server.mjs && node --check capture.mjs && node --check cli.mjs && node --check queue-consumer.mjs && node --check url-guard.mjs
